project.name: Starter: bdi-jpa-xa
project.description: XA transactions on the application datasource (the EAP xa-data-source), a build-time choice: add it next to bdi-jpa-postgresql, bdi-jpa-oracle or bdi-jpa-db2 when a transaction spans the database and another XA resource. The deploy role refuses an xa-data-source fragment for an artifact built without it.
